verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires a basic wiring-plan artifact for the initial prototype.
First target-specific delivery claim: the freelancer provides a concrete overview of the power supply, controllers, motors, and cooling connections.
The client accepts the electrically controlled solenoid-dispensing approach, requiring the wiring artifact to cover the valve and momentary button-control connections.
The freelancer confirms the client-defined acceptance condition that the milestone deliverable is a finalized wiring plan rather than another purchasing list.
The required powered lighting around the power button adds a concrete lighting circuit that the wiring artifact must document.
